_note: A guider service for one guide camera, run on the computer the camera is plugged into:
This example is all simulators (docs/guider.md): a simulated sky and FAU camera, the SX AO
protocol simulator, a simulated mount and backlight. For T2: camera kind zwo, tiptilt kind sxao
with its serial port, mount kind alpaca with the telescope's address, backlight kiwispec with the
KiwiSpec service URL, allow_hardware true AND --hardware -- only with JDE's approval (docs/guider.md,
Commissioning). Calibrate with POST /calibrate before guiding; results go to calibration_dir.
name: t2-guider
